input: Playwright mouse.wheel events delivered to a real browser page; these are not physical hardware input

checks.name: desktop chapters have at least three and a half screens of camera travel
a single wheel event produces intermediate frames and settles without overshoot
a rapid reverse wheel event follows the latest destination immediately
the chapter bar keeps a continuous background when the active chapter changes
photographs use real CSS depth and the spatial canvas paints within its clock budget
the photograph docks before the map and readable product controls enter
repeating the current chapter hash immediately aligns its camera and focus
pausing stops particles and active time while preserving page geometry and scroll
direct product and theatre hashes focus visible readable headings
the tested page reports no uncaught application errors

environment: Local headless Edge at a simulated 1440x1000 CSS viewport; synthetic wheel input and real DOM/canvas measurements
